# What does a game actually pay you per hour?

> Free pay calculator for referees, umpires and game officials: what you keep per game and per hour after the assignor fee, driving and taxes, how many games you need for a take-home goal, and the lowest fee worth the drive. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
